uncertainties.note: Several rows in the Berkt death/aftermath sequence are not speaker-tagged (formal 'watashi' narration, bitter asides, a farewell line). Translated literally in first person / neutral address; no character name or gender assigned beyond what is grammatically certain.

Source name is visibly cut off mid-word (matches 'Berkt' truncated before the final syllable); rendered as a similarly truncated 'Berk...' rather than restoring the full name, since the source itself is incomplete.

Reworded to 'the Vodarac high priest, Norb' (rather than 'a person named Norb, the Vodarac high priest') so that the book(83)/color(6) command order in English matches the source's book(83) before color(6) order exactly.
'Ark series' proposed as a plain descriptive term (see batch_09295_glossary_proposals.json); not previously locked, covers the existing Gun Ark/Blood Ark/Grave Ark family.
